what.text: This page follows Venezuelans in Costa Rica whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 19120 people in this group in Costa Rica, 0.3% of all Venezuelans in it.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data run from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group start in 2019 at 20828, and reached their highest point, 22401, at the end of 2020.
The figure was lower in 2024 and rose again in 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Costa Rica.
These are year-end totals for Costa Rica only, and the group is never added to refugees.
